top_signals.title: Iran Ready to Escalate War Trump Says Will End After US Election
top_signals.summary: Iran is ready for a more intense war and will escalate counterstrikes if the US continues attacking its territory and infrastructure, according to a senior official. Bloomberg's Erik Wasson has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
